verdict.rationale: E2B provides persistent sandboxes where processes and state survive pauses/timeouts (e2b-docs-3, e2b-docs-4, e2b-docs-5) and supports running code/commands programmatically, which could underpin agentic background tasks, but there is no evidence of built-in scheduling, triggers, or automation orchestration—it's positioned as sandbox infrastructure for AI-generated code execution, not an automation platform. Community feedback also notes agents can get stuck in loops needing manual intervention (e2b-comm-2), undercutting fully autonomous operation.
